name: Thriving Heath
oracle_text:
This land enters tapped. As it enters, choose a color other than white.
{T}: Add {W} or one mana of the chosen color.
blocked_sentences: As it enters, choose a color other than white.
{T}: Add {W} or one mana of the chosen color.

needs.what: an exclusion option on choose_color -- e.g. {"op": "choose_color", "except": ["W"]} -- so the self_enters choice offers only the four colours other than the printed one (the whole Thriving land cycle: "choose a color other than white")
needs.why_existing_wont_do: op_choose_color takes only 'prompt' and always asks over all five COLOR_CHOICES; choosing white would make the land tap for {W} only, a different card, and nothing in op_options lets the chooser's list be narrowed

needs.what: a mana ability that offers a fixed symbol OR the permanent's chosen colour -- a choose_mode whose modes are add_mana {W} and add_mana {"chosen_color_of": "self"} (or add_mana with mana {W} plus an or_chosen_color flag), with mana_options / the payment solver reading the chosen colour live
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The loader's chosen-colour path (mana_chosen_color in cards/loader/__init__.py) requires the {"chosen_color_of": "self"} add_mana to be the ability's single effect, and a choose_mode branch carrying a dynamic mana dict falls through to _mana_options, which freezes literal symbols at load time; the starting point's five-mode choose_mode taps for any colour, which is strictly better than the printed card. Splitting into two abilities ('{T}: Add {W}.' and '{T}: Add one mana of the chosen color.') leaves one printed line claimed by two abilities
